caption:
VEGAN Air Fryer Falafel 
i’ve been focused on quite a few meat based recipes so i thought today was the day to go vegan on the feed :) 

C: 40 | F: 4 | P: 12
Calories: 252 per portion (4 pieces)
Makes 8 pieces serves 2

Ingredients
120-130 grams chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained and dried
1 onion, chopped
10 garlic cloves
 1/2 cup of coriander leaves & 1/2 cup dill 
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp black pepper 
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp baking soda
white sesame seeds

Method
soak the chickpeas overnight then drain and dry in a kitchen towel
in a mixer, add in all ingredients mentioned in caption except the baking soda and sesame seeds
make a smooth ish mix in the blender and place in the fridge overnight
pro tip: use a proper blender or food processor, my nutribullet just struggled to get it done. 
next day, take the mix out, add in baking soda and sesame seeds and form patties
place a small piece of parchment paper covering the airfryer tray and brush a little oil
add your falafel and brush the tops and allow to airfry at 180 degrees, turn after 6-7 minutes and cook it properly
you can obviously deep fry them but
